description: This Java class defines an Android Activity that displays a dialog when an SMS message is received. It uses TextToSpeech to read out the message and provides options to reply or dismiss.

classes.name: SmsReceivedDialog
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles displaying an SMS received dialog and uses TTS to read the message aloud.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves SMS details from intent, shows a dialog, and sets up TextToSpeech.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for TTS initialization, sets language and starts speaking if successful.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the AlertDialog shown to the user indicating message receipt.
